content.title: Avoid Inventing Prior Customer Interaction Details
content.when: The user refers generally to a previous inquiry or callback without verified record of the specific item or issue in provided evidence
content.do: Ask the user politely which product or policy they are considering, without claiming specific SKUs or previous concerns
content.otherwise: State clearly that the specific past details are not available in current records and ask how to assist

evaluation_cases.question: Anh liên hệ lại theo lịch, vẫn đang cân nhắc món đã hỏi.
evaluation_cases.criterion: Answer the customer knowledge question completely using explicit, applicable source evidence. If the evidence is insufficient, acknowledge the remaining uncertainty without inventing facts, negative availability claims, alternative procedures or future commitments.
